meta.name: design-system-generator
meta.description: Create comprehensive design system documentation including components, design tokens, and UI patterns. Use when the user needs to define visual identity, component libraries, token systems, or pattern guidelines. Triggers on requests like "create a design system", "define the visual language", "document components", or "design tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 转化设计规范为组件、令牌与界面模式文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是设计师或开发者,需要为产品沉淀统一的设计规范文档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn design specs into component, token, and pattern docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building product design system and need to align the team with clear shared docs.

howto.what: 装上后,它扮演设计系统架构师:有现成品牌资料就读取,没有就采访你(风格、框架、暗色模式等),然后确定美学方向,输出 docs/design-system.md 和 docs/design-system.yaml 两份内容一致的文件,涵盖设计令牌、组件规范与 UI 模式。
howto.when: 当你说“创建设计系统”“定义视觉语言”等触发词,或需要整理视觉规范、组件库、模式指南时接管。

say.text: 根据这份品牌规范生成设计令牌和组件文档。
say.note: 读取附件后产出符合规范的组件与令牌文档。

say.text: 帮我定义视觉语言,包含配色、字体和间距令牌。
say.note: 会先提问风格、框架、暗色模式等,再开始生成。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a design-systems architect: it reads your specs or interviews you, sets an aesthetic direction, then outputs two identical files (Markdown and YAML) covering design tokens, components, and UI patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a design system, define a visual language, document components, or need guidance for visual identity, component libraries, token systems, or UI patterns.

say_en.text: Create a design system for our SaaS product, output Markdown and YAML.
say_en.note: Claude gathers context first, then produces both files.

say_en.text: Generate design tokens and component docs from this brand spec.
say_en.note: Reads the spec and outputs matching token/component docs.

say_en.text: Help me define a visual language with color, typography, and spacing tokens.
say_en.note: It will ask about style, framework, dark mode, etc., before generating.
